name: skylark_air_check_in_flight
intent: Check in for a SkyLark flight
description: Check in for a SkyLark flight to a selected city by going to My Trips, opening that trip, selecting the passenger, confirming no hazardous materials, and confirming check-in to obtain the boarding pass.
patterns: check me in for my flight

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: City of trip to check in

steps.intent: (single selection) Tap 'My Trips' to find the flight to {{trip_city}}
(single selection) In the list, tap the trip to {{trip_city}}
(single selection) Tap 'Check in' to start check-in for the {{trip_city}} trip
(single selection) Select the passenger shown on the booking to proceed with check-in
(single selection) Tap 'Continue' after selecting the passenger
(single selection) Select 'I'm not carrying hazardous materials'
(single selection) Tap 'Continue' after hazardous materials confirmation
(single selection) Tap 'Confirm check-in' to complete check-in for the flight to {{trip_city}}
